Test a full‑pool weighted combination with inverse‑error weights to see if including the weaker but complementary models improves the robust trend‑dominated series.
The series is trend dominated with unstable ranking; a robust trimmed mean over the full pool may reduce influence of outlier models.
test a robust weighted combo using softmax_neg_error on full pool to see if it improves over inverse_error; the series is trend dominated and ranking unstable, so a different weighting may help.
The series is trend dominated with unstable rankings; a robust median may outperform mean/weighted.
Test DBA on full pool for robust trend handling
The series shows unstable rankings and many correlated groups; a per‑horizon top‑k mean may capture complementary strengths across horizons.
Try a per‑horizon top‑k weighted combination on the full pool to capture horizon‑varying strengths; the series has moderate seasonality and unstable ranking, so per‑horizon may help.
Try a simple mean over the full pool to see if a neutral average beats the robust median, given the trend dominance and unstable rankings.
The series has unstable rankings and many correlated groups; a per‑horizon one‑hot weighting may capture changing best models across horizons.
Try a robust per‑horizon weighted mean with softmax_neg_error on the stable pool4 to see if per‑horizon weighting improves over the plain weighted inverse_error that underperformed.

decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 11 backtested attempts, score 0.6234. Series context: trend strength 0.882 and seasonal strength 0.4627; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.041); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 4.385.
